resources.string: Choose where to check ingredients. Mode changes apply immediately.
Matches ingredients and label warnings against the built-in allergen dictionary.
Uses the downloaded model to check one ingredient and one selected allergen at a time.
Uses your chosen cloud model to check the complete ingredient list for one selected allergen at a time.

Sends the complete ingredient list to the cloud LLM, or one ingredient at a time to Decisions, with one selected allergen per request. Photos and raw label text stay on your device. Label warnings use local matching rules. Requires an internet connection and your API key.
Uses the OpenRouter Decisions API to score one ingredient and one selected allergen at a time. Predictions at or above the threshold are flagged for review.
Enter the provider/model ID from OpenRouter.
Applies to OpenRouter LLM and Decisions. Default: 1. Local AI checks stay sequential.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 8.
Enter a model ID in provider/model format.
